nom: IT Cosmetics Bye Bye Pores Glycolic Acid Serum

avis.titre: Thank you for a simple, effective serum!
avis.texte: I really appreciate the simplicity of this glycolic serum. So many serums are filled with extras and fluff, this one isn't and I love it!! It works VERY well and very quickly. Zero skin sensitivities, redness or stinging. Just try it!

avis.titre: It works! But makes your skin very sensitive.
avis.texte: After a week of use, I am sold. I was looking at my face in the mirror this morning and had a quick moment of trying to remember if I took off my make up last night. My pores were so much smaller than normal/what I'm used to that I thought I still had a full face of make up on. I am hoping to see more improvement overtime. HOWEVER, I will say that this is very strong stuff and not made for sensitive skin. I just got done breastfeeding a couple of months ago and my hormones are all over the place. I've got a few spots with acne and it BURNS when I apply over the area. But if you look at the packaging, it DOES say to not apply to areas of irritated or broken skin. Another thing that happened was that I was laying on my crocheted blanket and I ended up having broken capillaries on my face in the pattern of the blanket. I feel like it had to do with the serum but it could be a coincident. Overall, I am happy with the product. It does what it says. I look better. And maybe I will use it every other day instead of every day.

I've always been kind of insecure about how large my pores are so I thought I would try this out. I've been using it every night for a month and I can't believe the progress I can already see. I can't stop looking at myself in the mirror!!
Such a difference! I cannot believe how good this has worked for pores on my chin!
Love the product!! Has reduced my pores size tremendously in conjunction with the toner. LOVE 'IT' PRODUCTS!!

avis.titre: Only thing works for my orange peel skin
avis.texte: Spent so much money on so many different so called works for pores miracle items. This is the only thing actually works on my huge pores.
Overall, it see,s Ike a good product and I wanted to lover. It did cause some scaling on my eye loads and overal thinness of my skin I thinking must be allergic to so,ethers Inv the ingredients
Love the feel and results with this product it definitely works!

avis.titre: Seems to work for large pores!
avis.texte: Been using this for just over 2 weeks, I put about 3 drops on every night before bed, and follow up with a gel moisturizer. I read about skin "purging" while starting glycolic acid, and I definitely experienced that. I broke out in several places as my skin was renewing cells and had to literally purge the gunk and dead skin. That lasted a week, and now seems to be done with. No reaction to every night use, skin seems softer and pores are smaller. Will continue using!
This stuff is the real deal if you want your pores gone use bye bye pores and say goodbye!

I've always had hormonal acne, but with pregnancy this product has been very helpful in reducing and preventing breakouts for me. I use 3 drops twice a day (after I wash my face) and it helped keep the breakouts to a minimum.

I have oily skin type with large pore. However, I didn't have any acne before using this product. I started using it combined with It Confidence in a Cream for a few days (only in evening) and realized that I awalys woke up having a few new whiteheads. And for my pore, I didn't notice any difference.

I have been using the serum for about a month now. I don't notice a difference in my pores but I do feel my skin tighter after I put it on. I have tried alternating wearing it at night and in the morning but I noticed that my skin tends to get even more oily if I apply it in the morning.
I didn't care for this product. I didn't like how it felt on my skin, it felt clogged.

I have sensitive skin but tend to get small bumps on my forehead and larger pores on my nose, and applying this at night has been very helpful! It's not a total transformation, but it makes a visible difference to me, especially in combination with their confidence in a face cream product!

This stuff is great!! I've had big pores on my nose all my life. I use Bye Bye Pores four times a week now. IT WORKS!! When I started using it a few months ago my husband said. "I don't know why, but you're looking even prettier."… I know why. It's the Bye Bye Pores. Great stuff.
Have used for 5 weeks, hasn't worked for me. Everybody skin is different.

avis.titre: Probably the best results I've had w/ a serum!
avis.texte: Finally a serum I can use and that WORKS on my sensitive skin!
Bought by accident but love it. I don't really have bad pores but good stuff
I love all it products. This does great with my sensitive skin.

I purchased this to try out along with the Confidence in A Gel lotion and CC Cream Foundation. Ive just been using ut for a few days now and WOW. I have noticed a difference in my skin already. I've not really used a serum before but have been searching for the right products to address my skin concerns which are mainly minimizing pores, evening out texture and tone, red and dark spots. I used this alone the first couple of times and I saw the change happen that quickly. My skin looks smoother, brighter, and feels taught. A little goes a long way! I also started using in the morning under the Gel Cream and together they are a match made in Heaven. I am so glad I took the chance to try this and I am looking forward to see what my skin looks like the more time that goes by.
I like the feel of it on my skin, not tacky. Does as it claims and smoothes the surface of my skin for makeup application.
First time user of this serum. It's decent. I can't say I have noticed less pores but time will tell. I use it in conjunction with Bye Bye Lines. I like the way it applies and feels on my face.
I have only been using this product for a short time but the difference in my pores is amazing

avis.titre: Noticing a difference after a few days
avis.texte: I saw a lot of comments talking about when results start to be noticeable and I could see a difference after literally 3 uses. Love it, will give a higher rating when I use the product for longer. Trying to get away from pore correction makeup

My pores look much better after putting this serum on. I'm unsure of what order I use it and the instructions don't make that clear. It does not work well before putting on foundation so I use it at night.
This has really helped my pores. Nothing is a permanent fix but I definitely see results with daily use. I'll keep using for sure
This product significantly changed the appearance of my huge pores.
This product leaves skin smooth as well I'm on my 6 th day of using and I'm noticing my pores shrinking already and I'm not being extra just for this review, but talking for reals.
Es muy bueno recomendado todos los productos deja la cara muy linda
I use this serum daily and have seen a difference in the size of my pores. A little goes a long way and it easy to use! This is my second bottle! I try to stock up when it's on sale!
Have been using for several months. My pores are smaller, and skin feels smoother. I have oily skin and this helps my face stay shine-free all day.
Used this for about 2 weeks but did not notice any difference in my pores.

Noticeable pore size reduction, and leave skin feeling smooth. Careful not to use on any cuts, a great to tell if your current methods are causing micro tears on your skin, you'll definitely feel it. Love this product and so does my husband…had to order more when my bottle went missing and realized my husband had taken it for himself.
Using this only 2 weeks and can already see the difference. Just can't say enough about this serum. It works. Use it every morning before moisturizer and bye bye redness.
To be honest it smoothed my skin a great deal, I had a learning curve with it and had to learn not to use it prior to sun exposure

avis.titre: A critical part of my skincare routine
avis.texte: When my prior source for 10% glycolic acid quit making their cream, I panicked. So happy to have found this product!
Not very good with powder foundation but excellent with liquid.
I've been using bye bye pores for 3 months and I can see results. Smaller pores that allows my foundation to go on smoother.

avis.titre: Great glycolic serum, very gentle but works.
avis.texte: This glycolic serum is mine and my sisters favorite skin care serum.

avis.titre: My favorite out of the serums
avis.texte: I have large pores and this is the only product that really helps
I alternate this with retinol cream. I definitely noticed a difference adding this into my routine.
Love your product I can immediately tell a difference after using them
I use this serum every night and my face looks great and my pores are nice and tight!
This serum is so smooth and thin, it feels like nothing on my skin. The results are amazing. I was a disbeliever, and I was proven wrong. I have no complaints at all.

avis.titre: Didn't work for me, hope it works for you
avis.texte: Read reviews and was hopeful that this product would decrease the appearance of pores on my nose. I have normal skin with pores being visible due to sebaceous filament build up, despite a fairly consistent skin care routine with toner, cleanser etc. I've used this for a little less than two months daily and have seen no visible difference. I'll continue to finish the bottle and hope for the best, but right now I'm disappointed.
I love this serum. I have only used it for about 10 days and I already see an improvement in the appearance of my pores!
One of my favorite products. Immediate and consistent results.
I need a something with help with my enlarging pores. As I grew older and this did The Thing.
This serum helps to minimize the appearance of pores when using under foundation. I have been looking for something like this for a while.
Have not noticed much difference in the look or size of pores
Bye Bye Pores didn't do what I expected of it. I do realize every product doesn't have the same effect on everyone the the same.! Wouldn't recommend it for myself.

The Bye Bye Pores Serum is now a staple item in my skin care routine! I use it after washing my face every morning and night! I also use the Bye Bye Lines after right after! Makes my skin feel and look hydrated, tighter, and healthy! LOVE IT!

avis.titre: Haven't  seen any results  yet but im hopeful
avis.texte: Im hoping that by me using daily I can see results by December cant expect an over night miracle

I struggle with the pores on my nose, so I wanted to try this product. It has been a game-changer. After washing my face at night, I put 1 drop on my nose, and rub it in, and a little goes a long way. If you have the little white things on your nose this is an excellent product for that.
I noticed a remarkable decrease in my pore size over just a few days. Since using this I have had almost zero acne break outs either. I actually ordering now for my son.

I used this along with their Niacinamide serum and I was absolutely amazed! I saw results immediately!! my skin feels and looks great, there's no trace of either serum aside from the astounding results! will always purchase these from now on, I am in love!

IT Bye Bye Pores was recommended to me by my adult daughter. I am a 65 year old male with a couple of skin autoimmune disorders. This product has worked wonders on my pores. It took ~4 weeks to begin to see changes. My daughter and I are very please with your product, we would highly recommend it.
Great Product that actually does what it says it will do. Used for over a year now and can tell a difference in my pore size!
It works wonderful , I'd recommend it to anyone. Great for my skin.
I love love love this I immediately saw results. My pores shrank almost overnight.

I've always had really smooth skin. About a week ago I started using the bye bye dark spot serum for some dark under eye melasma that appeared very early in my pregnancy and didn't go away postpartum. At the same time I started using the Bye Bye Dark Spots, I started using the Bye Bye Pores Serum.. since using the pores serum, my skin started looking rough and scaly. It BURNS when I first apply makeup, and it looks like I have developed a rash or acne of some sort. At this point I am not using either one of the serums because I'm not sure which one caused the rash.. I attached pictures of the rash on my face, the serums, and the before dark spots/rash free face. I wanted to love these products as much as I love the CC Cream, but I'm not sure if it's for me and I'm scared to continue use on my face.
I like the feel of this, but haven't notice a HUGE difference yet.
The difference in my skin after two weeks is remarkable. I can't wait to see what another two weeks does. I am so glad I purchased this.
I have used this product according to the directions for weeks, since the day it arrived. I have seen no difference in pore size. Seems to be a huge waste of money.
Make my skin itchy, and I'd wake up with painful white pimples and under skin pimples.
I am obsessed with it. Make my skin flawless. I use it right after washing my skin.
Not sure about this product. Don't see a big difference. Does feel good on the skin.
I've been using this product for a couple of weeks and have started to see some results. I'll keep using it.
Will continue to use. I feel like it's smoothing and hydrating
This is my 2nd bottle and I absolutely love this product. I have seen great results. It has definitely helped my pores
I like it. I have not seen a whole lot of improvement yet. I will keep using it to see more results. I use it three times per week as recommended as to not dry out my skin.
Bye Bye Pores does minimize the appearance of my pores and helps the application of my foundation because of its smoothness on my skin.
I think it works but my skin is a little sensitive for this product.
It's a bit early. I've been using this serum for about two weeks. But I love the way my skin looks and feels

I have been using this for 2 weeks now. My skin looks so much smoother! I have used glycolic products in the past and they stung and made my skin red so I discontinued use before I saw any result. This product never irritated my skin and after just a few days I could see my pores were less visible. I will keep using this in my daily regimen. Highly recommend!
I really feels like it removes pores and fine line and wrinkles.
I have been using this in my morning routine for about 2 months now ans it works great, have seen awesome results

avis.titre: My skin looks so much younger
avis.texte: I can really see a difference. I love the way this is treating my skin. I can see my pores minimizing
I like the Bye Bye serum line. Bye Bye Pores gives me a uniform glow surface before applying moisturizer. I have sensitive skin and it is really delicate.
Truly works! I have tried many products for pore minimizer and this is by far the best!

My skin is really sensitive and I can't use glycolic acid toner, so I thought I'd give this a shot. I'm really happy with it! I use it at night followed by the confidence in a cream night moisturizer and my skin hasn't flared up at all. The pores aren't dramatically smaller but I do notice a small change. I'm trying to use it more regularly - I think consistency is key.
I wasnt expecting too much bc shrinking pores is difficult. However after using this for 3-4 weeks, everyday, my pores have definitely shrunk. Im so excited!

avis.titre: Doesn't work at all,  waste of money
avis.texte: Been using this for 2 months, no results. I would like to know if I can get store credit and go back to the facial peel at night or the purple night cream. Birth of this did so much more for my pores.
It's a good product, it makes your Pores look smaller, and it not to drying, on your face. It's a Win, Win!
Helped minimize my pores and plump the skin, will purchase again!

This is my first try with any type of product containing hyaluronic & glycolic acid so I purchased because of my love for this brand and I was not disappointed. I use this daily and after dermaplaning.
I have huge pores on my nose, and this product is making a huge difference, only after a few days of use. Looking forward to seeing progress after a few weeks!
It real works for me. I use it before my make up and leaves my skin uniform. It looks and feels great.

I take good care of my skin so a little change in routine doesn't alway make for noticeable results. This particular serum though, the difference in the size of my pores and the way my foundation sits on my skin has made this a must have for me.

avis.titre: One of the best serums I've used
avis.texte: This is an great glycolic acid!! I saw a difference in my pores and skin tone within a few days! The product goes on smoothly and with little effort. I am definitely in love with this product

Only after a few days I noticed a difference. Without thinking about the product or potential results, I walked in bath room, looked in mirror after waking, and I was shocked. I immediately said "wow", it really does work. I have very large pores and to not notice them right off in the mirror was huge to me. It is a thick and gooey serum but not bad at all and easily washes off fingers. I use two drops on each side of my face and that is plenty to cover my face. Great product and I love the fact that it has the moisturizer in it also for fine lines.
I din't see a difference in the skin and my skin started peeeling
I've only had the product a few weeks but haven't notice any difference yet. I'm going to use the full bottle until I decide if it was worth it or not.
I'm so pleased with this product. My pores have almost disappeared. Certainly does what it says.

The product is not what I was expecting-it's very sticky and "gooey" and doesn't make my skin feel smooth. I have been using for a month and no visible results. I have used more expensive products in the past that work MUCH better. I was hoping to use this as a substitute, but as the saying goes, you get what you pay for. I did not like this product AT ALL.
I didn't believe that I would see results but I tried it anyway. I was happily surprised that I actually saw a difference and fast - within 1-2 weeks.

I've been using this product for 6 months now every night before bed. In the first use I saw significant reduction of my pores and by week one it was like my skin reversed time. I'm obsessed with this! I'm 41 and do use a lot of different anti aging products to stay looking young, and this one is a must have to that routine!

avis.titre: Enjoy product but not what I expected
avis.texte: Really like how this makes my face feel so soft and smooth. I really have not noticed any changes in my pore size however and been using this for months.
It's pretty good made my skin look smoother improved my scars

I have been using this product for 3 weeks now faithfully and haven't noticed a difference in the size of my pores. It feels good on my skin but that's about all so far. I will continue to use the bottle until it's gone unless after 3 more weeks I get no results. This might work for others but not right for me
this product is amazing. Use it twice a day. after morning shower and in evening after i was off my make up. Skin feels so soft. Wish i had started using it years ago.

avis.titre: Seems to exfoliate and clean pores
avis.texte: I struggle with clogged pores, and this serum unclogs the pores on my face! It really does reduce the appearance of my pores and has made my nose look great!
Smells great and easy to use. However, I have been using it for 2 weeks with no noticeable results.
It does what it says it'll do- minimizes pores! It has made a difference on my skin- my makeup also sets better & lasts longer without fading of smearing throughout my day!
I used daily and have seen improvement with minimizing pore appearance.
I didn't take a picture of my pores before this because I thought that maybe it wouldn't work but it does, and happened in a week, still cannot believe it.
